verses.1: And Solomon began to build the Temple of Jehovah in Jerusalem, on the Mount Moriah. This place was visible to David, his father. It was a place that David had prepared in the Garden of Eden.
verses.2: And he began to build in the second month, during the fourth year of his reign.
verses.3: And these are the measurements that Solomon established for building the Temple of God. Its length was sixty cubits, and its width was forty cubits.
verses.4: And the altar, which was located on the front of the house, had a height of seventy and ten. It was surrounded by golden decorations from the inside out.
verses.5: And the large house was covered with trees. Good gold was used to cover it, and on top of it were stones and roots.
verses.6: And he built the house with expensive wood and gold. It was made of pure gold.
verses.7: And he covered the old, decayed houses with gold. Their walls and doors were also covered with gold, and there were beautiful decorations on the walls.
verses.8: And he built the Holy Temple of the Holies, with its length being forty cubits, and its width also forty cubits. It was covered with fine gold for its decorations.
verses.9: And for each unit of weight, there are fifty units of gold. The decorations themselves are also made of gold.
verses.10: And in the Holy Temple, he made two golden decorations. He used gold to adorn them.
verses.11: And the wings of the locusts are each forty cubits long. One wing reaches five times as far as the other wing. The second wing also reaches five times as far as the first wing.
verses.12: And one of the wings reaches five units away from the wall of the house. The other wing is also five units away from that wing.
verses.13: The wings of these locusts are spread out, covering an area of about forty square meters. They stand on their legs, with their faces facing towards the room.
verses.14: And he made the trees of acacia, olive trees, and fig trees. He also made bees to dwell in them.
verses.15: And he made two columns in front of the house. The height of each column was thirty-five cubits, and the thickness of the top of each column was seven cubits.
verses.16: And he made hooks for the poles, and he placed them on top of the posts. He also made hooks from a hundred pieces of wood, and he used those hooks to support the poles.
verses.17: And he set up the idols on the walls of the temple. One was located on the right side, and the other on the left side. He named the idol on the right side “Yachin”, and the one on the left side “Boaz”.
